headline: Approved property and motor vehicle tax refunds of $4,417.19, $21,352.41, and $107,100,20.
summary: One member of the public gave input. Members discussed an update to the budget ordinance, but the minutes record no vote on it. The chair said a joint communication from the Council and the Mayor on the town's audit would follow a meeting with auditors, along with an amended budget timeline that includes revised October due dates.
decisions: Approved a refund of $4,417.19 in property and motor vehicle taxes collected before 7/1/2025; passed unanimously.
Approved a refund of $21,352.41 in motor vehicle taxes collected between 7/1/2025 and 6/30/2026; passed unanimously.
Approved a refund of $107,100,20 in property tax collected between 7/1/25 and 6/30/26; passed unanimously.
Moved the consulting services agreement with Clifton Larson Allen LLP out of committee without recommendation, for the August 13, 2026 agenda; passed unanimously.

Chair Alston seconded the motion. Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING 
AUGUST 10, 2026 – MINUTES DRAFT 
 Committee Chair: 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Committee Vice Chair: 
 Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Committee Members: 
Absent -Ted Stevens 
 Present - Tom Figlar 
 Present - Tasha Hunt 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
 Present - Abdul Osmanu 
 Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
 Present - Katie Kiely, President 
 
  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Finance Committee Meeting, August 10, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was called to order at 
8:10pm with the members noted above present. 
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
One member of the public provided public input. 
 
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming meetings for the Finance Commission and Board of Assessment 
Appeals was shared. There were no other Board, Committee or Department updates for this 
evening’s meeting.  
  
4. ACTION ITEMS 
 
1. Discussion of Budget Ordinance Update 
Vice Chair Caldwell moved to open the item for discussion; Chair Alston seconded.  
Following a lively discussion, Chair Alston closed discussion on the item at 9:00pm. 
  
  2. Refund of Property and Motor Vehicle Taxes collected prior to 7/1/2025. 
$4,417.19 
Council member Figlar motioned to open the item; Majority Leader Gallagher 
seconded.  Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously.
3. Refund of Motor Vehicle Taxes collected between 7/1/2025 and 6/30/2026 
$21,352.41 
Majority Leader Gallagher moved to open the item; Council member Hunt seconded.  
Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously. 
  
  4. Refund of Property Tax collected between 7/1/25 and 6/30/26  
$107,100,20 
Council member Figlar motioned to open the item which was seconded by Council 
member Osmanu. Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously. 
  
5. NEW BUSINESS  
  1. Order Authorizing Additional Services Consulting Services Agreement with Clifton 
Larson Allen LLP (CLA) Finance Department 
Majority Leader Gallagher made a motion to move this out of Committee without 
recommendation and see it on the agenda for Thursday, August 13, 2026.  Chair 
Alston seconded the motion.  Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously. 
  
6. POTENTIAL UPCOMING ITEMS 
Committee Chair along with corresponding department heads (i.e., the Mayor's Office) to 
give an update. 
  1. Joint Communication with Finance Chair Alston, Mayor Sendroff, and Council 
President Kiely on the Audit Timeline.  
  2. Amendment to Budget Timeline Anticipated Update Meeting October 
Speaking to items 6.1 and 6.2, Chair Alston noted that a joint communication from 
the Council and the Mayor regarding the Town’s audit would be issued following a 
meeting with the auditors, and that an amendment to the anticipated budget timeline, 
including revised October due dates, would be forthcoming. 
 
  
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Alston called for a motion to adjourn.  
Motion was made by Council member Teodosio and seconded by Council member Figlar.  The 
meeting adjourned at 9:02pm.
